newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wing Hang Bnk FRCD raised to HK$1.38 bln.
newsitem.headline: Wing Hang Bnk FRCD raised to HK$1.38 bln.

text.p: Wing Hang Bank's floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been increased to HK$1.38 billion from HK$1.2 billion due to oversubscription, said arranger Jardine Fleming Bank.

The three-year certificates were issued at par to float at 30 basis points over the three-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 43 basis points.
The issue was off the bank's HK$3.0 billion CD programme.
Application has been made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the issue as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF), or discount window.
Arrangers are Chase Manhattan Asia, Schroders Asia, Jardine Fleming Bank and Sakura Finance Asia.
Co-arrangers are Bank Austria's Hongkong branch, China Development Finance Co (Hong Kong), Commerz (East Asia), Dresdner (South East Asia), Standard Chartered Bank and WestLB.
Co-lead managers are ABN Amro Bank and BNP's Hongkong branch.
Senior managers are Banca Nazionale del Lavoro's Hongkong branch and Hang Seng Bank.

Managers are BW Bank Ireland, Asahi Finance (Hong Kong), Banco Central Hispanoamericano's Hongkong branch, Cariplo's Hongkong branch, Ka Wah Bank and Republic National Bank of New York's Hongkong branch.
Signing is set for May 16 in Hong Kong. The payment date is May 28.
